assets.prompt: Create a cinematic science-fiction oil painting for Escape Velocity's scrolling opening story. A hopeful human space frontier: small weathered cargo shuttle and ore freighter sailing past the blue curve of an ocean planet, distant new colonies, star lanes opening into a vast luminous galaxy. Elegant hand-painted brushwork, rich atmospheric depth, luminous restrained highlights, classic painted 1990s science-fiction book-cover quality, deep midnight blue and black with amber accents. Landscape 16:9. Place main storytelling imagery in the OUTER left and right thirds, leave the central third mostly dark quiet space for white scrolling text. Edges dissolve into near-black, no border. No text, lettering, captions, logos, UI, or watermarks. Detailed original spacecraft, no recognizable franchise designs. Cohesive painterly aesthetic, not a photograph or glossy video-game screenshot.
